reference: User-supplied Chinese shadow-puppet contact sheet used as aesthetic reference only. All puppet artwork is newly generated; no figures or advertising copied.

characters.name: 金童
characters.character: 年輕天庭侍者；先顧玉女，後顧自己。清秀側臉、雲紋長袍、簡潔冠帽。
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Chinese shadow-puppet character CUTOUT RIG ATLAS for a small animated theatre game.
Create a transparent PNG sprite atlas, landscape 1536 by 1024, six separate pieces in a STRICT 3 columns by 2 rows invisible grid, each cell 512 by 512. No grid lines, no labels, no words, no numerals, no scene. Genuine transparent background and transparent pierced holes.
Character: JINTONG, a youthful male celestial attendant, slender elegant side profile facing RIGHT. Black traditional Chinese leather shadow-puppet aesthetic: crisp solid black pierced silhouette, many elegant floral/cloud negative-space cutouts like hand-cut Chinese shadow theatre, modest ancient headdress, gentle clean-shaven profile with one tiny pierced eye. No photorealism, no shadows, no gradients, no white fill. Traditional profile rather than generic human icon. Original design, no watermarks or advertising.
All pieces are disassembled parts of ONE consistent puppet and must fit together at a shared source scale. Shapes remain separate with at least 48px transparent margin, exactly one part per cell.
TOP LEFT cell: torso plus entire long ceremonial robe and feet, upright, NO HEAD and NO ARMS. Body from neck socket to feet about 400px tall, centered in cell, neck at (256,56), feet at y456. Beautiful long narrow robe with intricate geometric/cloud lattice cutouts.
TOP MIDDLE cell: detached head with headdress, facing RIGHT, head and neck together about 128px tall, center at (768,256). Neck ends in a rounded black pivot tab. Keep slender youthful profile.
TOP RIGHT cell: detached upper arm with patterned flared sleeve, pointing horizontally RIGHT, rounded shoulder pivot at left and elbow pivot at right. About 180px long and 62px tall, centered in cell.
BOTTOM LEFT cell: detached forearm and delicate hand, pointing horizontally RIGHT, round elbow pivot left, hand right. About 160px long and 36px tall, centered in cell.
BOTTOM MIDDLE cell: second matching upper arm with patterned sleeve, pointing RIGHT, same size as top right, centered in cell.
BOTTOM RIGHT cell: detached ancient wine ewer, black silhouette with pierced decoration, elegant spout pointing RIGHT and loop handle, about 105px tall, centered in cell.
No assembly example or extra parts. Important: top-left body MUST NOT include arms or head; the small parts must retain actual smaller shared-scale sizes, not fill their cells. Flat silhouette texture, ready for separate head and arm rotation animation.

characters.name: 玉女
characters.character: 年輕天庭侍女；關心藏在提醒與嗔怪中。有主見，危急時會主動伸手。雙髻花簪、花卉鏤空長裙。
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Chinese shadow-puppet character CUTOUT RIG ATLAS for an animated theatre game.
Transparent PNG sprite atlas, landscape exactly 1536 by 1024. STRICT invisible 3 columns x 2 rows grid, each cell 512 by 512. Genuine transparent background, including transparent pierced holes, not white or black background. No labels, text, numbers, outlines around cells, grid, watermark, stage or cast shadows.
Character: YUNU, a youthful female celestial attendant, slender and graceful, classic Chinese shadow-theatre side profile facing RIGHT. Hair in a compact elegant double bun with modest floral hairpins. Crisp jet black hand-cut leather silhouette with elaborate but legible pierced plum blossom, cloud and lattice motifs; slender visible nose, one tiny pierced eye, tiny mouth. Long layered ceremonial skirt and modest flowing sleeves. Original traditional pierced shadow-puppet design, not a generic icon or modern cartoon. Completely flat black silhouette, with many genuine transparent holes for light to shine through. No grey glow and no shading.
All pieces are disassembled parts of ONE consistent puppet, at the SAME SOURCE SCALE so they assemble without major resizing. Each part fully isolated in its own cell with transparent margins. Do not add a complete assembled character elsewhere.
TOP LEFT cell (0..512,0..512): torso plus long layered skirt and small pointed shoe, upright, NO HEAD and NO ARMS. Neck socket at (256,56), feet around y456. Body about 400px tall. Rich lace-like transparent cutwork around skirt, chest and collar, but keep joints opaque.
TOP MIDDLE cell: detached head with hair buns and slender neck tab, profile RIGHT, about 128px tall centered at (768,256).
TOP RIGHT cell: detached front upper arm with matching carved flared sleeve, horizontally RIGHT, round shoulder pivot at left and elbow pivot at right, about 180px long by 62px high, centered at (1280,256).
BOTTOM LEFT cell: detached forearm with a delicate open hand reaching RIGHT, rounded elbow pivot at left, about 160px long by 36px high, centered at (256,768).
BOTTOM MIDDLE cell: second matching upper arm with carved sleeve pointing RIGHT, same 180px by 62px, centered at (768,768).
BOTTOM RIGHT cell: detached shallow ceremonial wine cup on a small stem with two tiny handles, black carved silhouette, about 72px wide by 50px tall, centered at (1280,768).
Uniform scale means the little head, arms and cup should NOT fill their cells. No arms or head on the body. No objects touching cell boundaries. This is production 2D articulated puppet artwork intended to be assembled and animated with shoulder, elbow and neck pivots.

animation: Images stay unchanged. SVG viewports select atlas regions, joints rotate at neck/shoulder/elbow/wrist; two-bone IK positions the hands. Cup release and three clipped cup shards are animated in stage coordinates.
scope: 第〇世使用生成角色；七夕宴八段有獨立動作時間軸，其後天庭段落使用同一組角色與基礎姿態。其他角色仍為原有暫代剪影。
